notes: A cohort-refresh pass refused 13 of 34 cohorts. Every one of the thirteen was a provider HTTP failure — twelve 429s inside a four-second window, plus one 502. Not enrichment, not ranks, not renamed fields, not deleted screens. The refusal itself was correct, and is unchanged: *"membership is UNKNOWN, not empty."* Everything downstream of it was not, and the five defects are one family — a system that knew a thing and had no way to say it. 1.
